name: la-agencia
description: Consultora de software por agentes de IA — open source, local, multi-harness

scripts.build: npm run build -w @la-agencia/shared && npm run build -w @la-agencia/server && npm run build -w @la-agencia/web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run sidecar:build && npm run dev -w @la-agencia/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run sidecar:build && npm run tauri -w @la-agencia/desktop -- build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @la-agencia/shared && npm run typecheck -w @la-agencia/server && npm run typecheck -w @la-agencia/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run spdx:check && npm run reuse:check && npm run versions:check && npm run catalog:validate && npm run assets:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run licenses:check && npm run audit:check
